title: 面向模型校准的摊销局部后验推断及其在海洋湍流闭合中的应用
summary: 该研究提出按目标情境邻近度加权观测似然构建局部后验族，用高斯局部化权重纳入情境不确定性，并以条件归一化流进行摊销变分推断。在Branin-Hoo模型和海洋k-ε湍流闭合实验中，局部化校准相比全局后验降低了预测误差。
summary_en: This work constructs a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods by proximity to a target context, incorporating context uncertainty via Gaussian localization weights with covariance inflation. A conditional normalizing flow performs amortized variational inference. In Branin-Hoo and ocean k-epsilon turbulence closure experiments, localized calibration reduces predictive errors versus global posteriors.
